Rule: Project dates must be logically ordered and use the project timezone.
Percent complete must be between 0 and 100 and conform to the selected progress method.
Schedule relationships may not create unapproved circular logic.
Actual finish requires actual start and 100 percent completion.
Budget and cost transaction amounts require currency and non-null cost-code mapping.
Daily labor hours exceeding tenant thresholds require explanation and approval.
Equipment meter readings may not decrease unless a documented meter replacement or correction exists.
Production quantities require a valid unit and cannot duplicate the same source event.
Document revision identifiers must be unique within the document series.
RFI due dates may not precede the issue date.
Submittal review cycles must preserve reviewer, disposition, dates, and returned files.
Change-order values must equal the sum of approved change lines within tolerance.
Invoices may not exceed commitment balance without a controlled exception.
Retainage percentages must remain within contract-defined limits.
Inspection results require checklist completion or documented not-applicable reasons.
Incident records require severity, date/time, location, reporter, and notification status.
Offline payloads must pass schema, authorization, version, and malware checks.
External portal shares require an expiration date unless policy explicitly allows otherwise.
AI-generated claims must include confidence, evidence references, and model/task version.
Closeout cannot be approved while mandatory unresolved punch or warranty-prep items remain.
